decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the works being implemented a trial study shall be carried out (trialled over a small area), that secures the removal of markings by the Doss or Jof methods. The whole works shall be carried out in accordance with the results of that study.
Condition : 5 - Biological material generally is to be thoroughly cleaned off prior to repair and repointing, to ensure best results.

Condition : 6 - The existing typical mortar should be analysed and the results used to inform the grades of sand and lime to be used.The samples of lime putty specification together with proposed performance, and final finish of the repointing shall be more fully identified and agreed with the local planning authority before implementation.
Condition : 7 - A detailed photographic record of the condition and appearance of the wall shall be taken and provided to the Council prior to the works being carried out.
description: Repair and re-pointing of existing listed wall.
